name: GE Vernova Hitachi Nuclear Energy
description: US-Japan joint venture of GE Vernova and Hitachi owning the BWRX-300 boiling-water SMR, the first grid-scale SMR under construction in the Western world (Darlington, Canada; first unit targeted for 2030), plus the ESBWR and ABWR large reactors.
